name: Dixon Lake Campground
note: City of Escondido campground above Dixon Lake. 45 sites for tents or RVs to 35 ft, about 10 full-hookup (30-amp) sites - most suit mid-size rigs; showers, dump. Reservable. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: City of Escondido Dixon Lake fees (effective 2024-09-15): full-hookup campsite $60 a night, tent-only $35, $5 reservation fee, $5 extra vehicle, $1 per dog.

name: Lost Creek Campground (WY-70, Encampment)
note: Medicine Bow NF campground on the Battle Highway (WY-70) 18 miles west of Encampment, ~8,800 ft. 13 back-in sites in the trees; the FS calls them small and for trailers under 22 ft, though the measured driveways run 25-99 ft - a 23-ft rig is at the stated edge. Vault toilet, no drinking water, no trash service, no hookups. Some sites reservable, season mid-June to September. Baby Lakes Trail into the Huston Park Wilderness across the highway. --Claude

name: Branched Oak State Recreation Area - Southshore Campground
note: Nebraska Game and Parks, Area 1 on the south shore of Branched Oak Lake northwest of Lincoln; Middle Oak Creek (Area 4) is a separate entry. Paved herringbone loops on an open grassy point and the shore: the east loop's front row (sites 43-49) ends about 20 m from the water across grass and a sandy strip, and the point's outer pads are 25-60 m from the riprapped shore. A middle loop of pads between the two is not on the booking site. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: On 2026-11-05 the booking site's window ran to May 4, 2027 (180 days). South Shore site calendars show every night first come, first served through April 11, 2027, and reservable from April 12, 2027.
field_notes.Fees: Basic $15, electric $25, Electric Plus $30, full hookup $35 per night (2025 statewide rates); plus the Nebraska park entry permit.
field_notes.Sites: 78 South Shore sites are on the booking site (35 Electric, 31 Electric Plus, 12 Full Hookup), Max Vehicle Length 40-100 ft; imagery shows a further herringbone loop of about 30 pads between the two booked loops that the booking site does not list.

name: Gorges State Park Campground
note: NC State Parks, Grassy Ridge area near Sapphire on the Blue Ridge escarpment. Family campground with tent sites and five camper cabins; bathhouse. Bear-active park: food and scented items go in the bear-proof box at the site. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Booking page: campsites (electric and non-electric) 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival. The park gate is locked daily at posted closing hours (general park hours 7am-9pm); no vehicle access after closing except in an emergency.
field_notes.Fees: $45 a night for the 14 hookup sites, the only ones a 23-ft rig fits (every non-hookup site has a 20-ft back-in driveway; those are $30), including the $3-a-night reservation fee. The same on a Saturday; no out-of-state rate. NC State Parks' booking site, June 2027 nights, read 2026-10-12; driveway lengths read 2026-10-22.
field_notes.Sites: 14 full-hookup sites (017-030) with 50-ft paved back-in driveways; 16 non-electric sites (001-016) with 20-ft back-in driveways, too short for a 23-ft rig. Five camper cabins in the same campground.

name: Buffalo Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic 52-site Wisconsin DNR campground in the southern Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest, on the southeast corner of Buffalo Lake near Woodruff. No hookups; three vault toilets and three hand pumps, sand beach and boat ramp. Pads are uneven - reviewers say take care over ~30 ft. Open about April 30 to Columbus Day. Reservable on the Wisconsin DNR system; state park vehicle admission sticker required. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Approximate: the DNR says April 30 to Columbus Day.
field_notes.Fees: Base nightly fee (before any nonresident surcharge) for RV-capable sites (46 sites, 1 fee schedules), Tuesday nights 2027-05-11 and 2027-06-15, from the wisconsin.goingtocamp.com site fee panel.

name: East Star Lake Campground - Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest
note: Rustic 30-site Wisconsin DNR campground on the southeast corner of 1,206-acre Star Lake near Sayner, Northern Highland-American Legion State Forest. No hookups; two vault toilets, two hand pumps, boat launch. Open the Thursday before Memorial Day to Labor Day. Reservable on the Wisconsin DNR system; vehicle admission sticker required. Rig length not published. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Approximate: the DNR says the Thursday before Memorial Day to Labor Day.
field_notes.Fees: Base nightly fee (before any nonresident surcharge) for RV-capable sites (26 sites, 1 fee schedules), Tuesday nights 2027-05-11 and 2027-06-15, from the wisconsin.goingtocamp.com site fee panel.

name: Brighton Recreation Area - Murray Lake Rustic Campground
note: Rustic campground in an oak forest near Murray Lake in Brighton Recreation Area, with direct access to a trail open to mountain biking. Open Memorial Day through Labor Day on weekends only (Friday through Sunday). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Reserve at MiDNRReservations.com or call 800-447-2757. Reservable on weekends only, matching the campground's Memorial Day - Labor Day weekend-only (Friday-Sunday) operation.
field_notes.Fees: $20 a night on the booking site for 2027 (probed 2027-05-20, 07-13, Sat 07-17) and 2026; the DNR's 2026 table also gives $20. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry.
field_notes.Sites: Allowed equipment by site on the booking site: 3 tent-only, 12 to 20 ft, 8 to 30 ft, 2 to 40 ft, so only ten sites take a 23-ft rig.

name: Jack Pine Lodge, Resort & Campground
note: Campground behind the Jack Pine Lodge bar and grill on M-94, about 20 minutes north of Manistique in the Hiawatha National Forest, at the Haywire ORV trailhead; rustic sites are for vans and tents only, and there are cabins. Gas on site. Nightly and seasonal stays. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Read on CampLife (2026-10-14): one night, before tax, is $47 on a water-and-electric site and $53 on a full-hookup site, October 2026 and June 2027 alike, and each stay also carries a flat $5. Rustic sites ($33) take only vans and tents and are left out. Seasonal sites are $2,499 plus electric.
field_notes.Sites: The operator's CampLife description (2026 rates) says 64 sites, most with water and electric, 46 with sewer, 11 pull-throughs; its own home page (headed '2025 Rates') still says 56 sites with 48 sewer. CampLife sells 46 full-hookup, 8 water/electric and 8 rustic sites (the rustic ones 'Tent and Van Only', 25 ft), plus 6 cabins.

name: River Valley RV Park
note: Family campground west of Gladwin around a small lake, with a beach, a lake-view trail, kayak and paddleboard rentals and kids' activities; run for 40+ years, under the Meihls family since 2024. Tent sites have power but take no RVs. Seasonal sites are leased by the year (May 1 to October 1), by waiting list for repeat campers. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Operator's rates page (2026 site): electric and water site $50 a night ($350 weekly, $900 monthly). Tent sites ($40, $45 on holidays) have 110V power but 'No RVs of any kind are allowed on Tent Sites'; rustic sites (no power or water) $35 + $5 on holidays; rustic cabins $70. Daily visitors $5 per car; holding-tank dump service $20. Read 2026-10-22.

name: Chain O' Lakes Campground
note: Campground at 7231 S. M-88 near Bellaire in the Chain of Lakes area; concrete and gravel full-hookup sites (back-in and pull-through), water/electric back-ins, tent sites and cabins, with a pool. Boat parking allowed at some sites if the boat fits on the pad. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Online through the operator's Firefly Reservations page ('RESERVE NOW'). Without the optional $15 site lock the system may move you to another site. After-hours arrivals find their site on the check-in board by the office. Posted RV length restrictions (hitch and bumper included) are enforced per site.
field_notes.Fees: Operator's rates page: water & electric 30-amp gravel back-in $44/night; full hookup 30-amp gravel back-in $48, 30-amp gravel pull-through $50, 30/50-amp gravel pull-through $52, 30/50-amp concrete back-in $55; tent site $35. Rates include 2 adults and 2 children (extra $5/person/night); pets $5/dog/night; optional $15 site lock; 7th night free. Seasonal and monthly by inquiry.

name: Camp Deer Trails
note: Family-owned camp on 140 wooded acres along the east shore of Long Lake south of Harrison (6651 N Eberhart Ave), with half a mile of lakefront, three beaches, docks, canoes, kayaks and paddle boats and a private island; also cabins, a lodge and weddings/events. RV sites are rustic back-in sites, rustic waterfront (bluff) sites and newly built 30/50-amp electric sites; arrive with a full fresh-water tank. Not on RV Life; Campspot 4.7 over 31 verified reviews; Good Sam lists it unrated. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Book online through the operator's Campspot page ('Book Now' on campdeertrail.com) or call (231) 250-2051. Campspot refused one-night stays with 'There is a 2 night minimum over the requested period of time' on every date quoted (Tuesdays and Saturdays in October 2026); 2027 dates were not yet open to check whether summer differs. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am.
field_notes.Fees: Campspot, October 2026: Rustic RV site (motorhomes allowed) $25 a night any night; 30/50-amp electric $45 weeknights, $55 Saturday; rustic waterfront $35 (offered to vans, trailers and fifth-wheels but not to motorhomes). Plus a $2 Reservation Surcharge and Campspot's $3 booking fee, each charged once per stay, and tax.
field_notes.Sites: 29 RV sites on Campspot: 12 30/50-amp electric and 10 rustic (to 40 ft, motorhomes allowed), 7 rustic waterfront (to 30 ft; Campspot's rig list for them omits motorhomes), all back-in; plus 7 tent sites (3 wooded, 4 waterfront).

name: Yogi Bear's Jellystone Park Camp-Resort Grayling
note: Franchise Jellystone Park in the woods outside Grayling.  A site may share its water and electric pedestal with another, so extension cords and extra hoses may be needed, and sewer sites are limited.  There is a pool (no lifeguard), a jumping pillow, mini golf, a Silent Disco (new in 2026) and a Bear Factory; day passes cost $15 a person, Sunday to Thursday, and early check-in $35.  The person booking must be 21 and a site holds one immediate family; e-bikes, EV charging and outside firewood aren't allowed, nor are golf carts for overnight guests.  Two dogs at most; quiet hours run from 11 p.m. to 8 a.m.  Cabins and RVs are rented. --Claude

Booking: min stay 2 nights on weekends (seen on Saturday, June 12, 2027)

field_notes.Season: The park says 'Opening April, Closing October' (no days given).
field_notes.Booking: Booked on the park's own Campspot page. On a June 2027 Saturday Campspot asked for at least 2 nights with no Saturday arrival or departure; a Tuesday sold one night. Must be 21 to rent; one immediate family per site. Cancellations by phone only.
field_notes.Fees: Campspot, one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax, June 2027: Water/Electric RV Site $50 on a Tuesday, $75 on a Saturday; Water/Electric/Sewer $60 / $90 (both types sold to Class A/B/C motorhomes). No per-night fee on the quote, only the park's $5 'Reservation Fee' once per stay (read 2026-10-13). Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children; visitors pay a fee at the Ranger Station. A campsite cancelled 2+ weeks out is refunded less a $35 booking fee, the $5 reservation fee and any site-lock fee. Early check-in or late check-out $35. Campspot offered no sites in October 2026 or January 2027.
field_notes.Sites: Campspot sells 61 Water/Electric RV sites (to 76 ft, pull-throughs among them) and 76 Water/Electric/Sewer sites (to 64 ft), plus two group sites (48/49 and 15A-C, to 42 ft) and cabins and RV rentals. The park also has seasonal campers; their share isn't published.

name: Penn's Creek Campground
note: Wooded campground on Penns Creek at Millmont (Union Co); about 50 sites. Full-hookup sites (water, sewer, electric), tent sites $35. Google 4.3 over 79 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Season: 2026 opening day April 15; closing date not stated.
field_notes.Booking: Online booking on the campground's own site (Premier Campground Management); holiday weekends by phone or text only (570-274-5995). No office hours or check-in: go straight to the site. Cancel more than 8 days out for a full refund less $5; 7-3 days, less the first night; under 3 days, no refund.
field_notes.Fees: Full hook-up (water, sewer, electric) $45 a night; tent/small-RV sites with water and electric, for tents, pop-ups or RVs up to about 24 ft, $35. Firewood $5 a bundle. 2026 season page, read 2026-10-20.

name: Riverlands Recreation Area
note: Small year-round RV park and cabins near Berwick with a store and breakfast restaurant on site (not the PPL/Talen Susquehanna Riverlands); 34 full-hookup 30/50-amp RV sites, utilities included, plus 17 cabins and primitive tent sites. RV sites $40/night weekly (operator's rates page, (c) 2025). Google 3.4 over 12 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: Full hook-up RV site $48 a night, $40 a night by the week, $38 by the month, all utilities included; cabins $110. Cancellations 14+ days out are refunded less $10, later ones not at all. Rates page (c) 2025, read 2026-10-20.

name: Timber Haus Campground
note: Campground near Clarington and Cook Forest State Park, next door to White's Haven; electric & water RV sites, full hookups, plus cabins, hotel rooms and tent sites. Under new ownership and upgrading its sites (2026). Seasonal (not year-round). Google 4.5 over 109 reviews (RV Life lists it unrated). --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Book online (ResNexus) or call (814) 646-7750. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am. Cancellations more than 14 days out are refunded less card fees; 7-14 days 50%.
field_notes.Fees: Electric & water RV sites from $50/night, full hookup from $55 ($310/$340 a week, $500/$600 a month); tent sites from $35; seasonal RV sites from $2,400/season. +$20 per extra tent on an RV site. The FAQ's 'RV site rates starting at $35/night' is the tent-site figure on the rates page.
field_notes.Sites: 34 sites in all (full-hookup and electric/water RV, tent, plus seasonal RV sites), besides cabins and hotel rooms; RVs up to 42 ft (call to confirm).

name: Spruce Lake Retreat Family Campground
note: Christian retreat center's family campground near Canadensis in the Poconos, open to the public by the night; 900 forested acres with trails and waterfalls. Water and electric on all sites (most 20-amp), sites 24-35 ft. Program weekends and family weeks priced as packages. 2-night weekend minimum. Google 4.7 over 399 reviews for the retreat center (RV Life lists it unrated). --Claude

Booking: min stay 2 nights on weekends, 3 on holidays
Fees: +$10/night each adult over 2, children 17 and under free, 8 people max

field_notes.Season: Nightly stays 'April through October'; seasonal rentals April 15 to October 15.
field_notes.Booking: Call 800.822.7505 or use the 'Get a Quote' form to book; $47 nonrefundable deposit. Weekends 2-night minimum; Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends 3-night minimum (sold as program packages). Stays up to 14 days. Check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm. No pets (service animals by arrangement); no alcohol.
field_notes.Fees: 2026: $47/site/night on non-program dates for 2 adults and children under 18 (up to 8 people); extra adults $10/night ($15 during programs). Program weekends and family weeks are sold as packages: Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends $186, July Family Week $248, August Family Week $312. A $47 nonrefundable deposit is required.
field_notes.Sites: 30 nightly sites, 24-35 ft long, all with water and electric (most 20-amp; sites 1-6 and 16-20 have 20/30/50-amp, 11-12 also septic). One RV and one tent, or two tents, per site; up to 8 people. 33 sites are also rented seasonally (April 15 - October 15).

name: Creeper Trail Campground
note: Small campground at Whitetop on the Virginia Creeper Trail (bike shuttles); 28 sites incl. 30- and 50-amp RV sites, electric tent sites. Google 4.7 over 121 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Season: 2026 season May 1 - October 31; 2027 season April 16 - October 31.
field_notes.Booking: Booked per site on the campground's own site ('Book now' / reservation form on each site page). Group sites need a $50/night deposit.
field_notes.Fees: Creeper Trail: RV sites (30/50-amp) from $45 a night plus taxes and fees. Read 2026-10-15.
field_notes.Sites: Nine RV sites with electric and water, posted maximum RV/trailer lengths: site 1 24 ft, 2 20, 3 18, 4 20 (its text says 22), 5 20, 6 18, 7 20, 8 28, 9 28. Only sites 1, 8 and 9 (and 4 at 22 ft) take a 23-ft rig; the two septic sites (5, 6) are 18-20 ft. The access roads are curvy and 'not advised for pull-behind campers longer than 28 feet'. Also electric tent, primitive tent and group sites.

name: Riverside Camp and Marina
note: Small campground and marina on the Chickahominy River at Lanexa, between Richmond and Williamsburg; large back-in full-hookup sites with water views. 3-night minimum on holidays; 20A tent $45. Google 4.6 over 101 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: 'Check Availability' / 'BOOK NOW' go to Campspot. Holidays need 3 nights. Arrivals outside business hours must make arrangements (after hours 804-326-4488); no arrivals after 10 PM without prior arrangement. Avoid Rockahock Rd and Carter Rd in a big rig; use Waterside Dr (627) off US 60.
field_notes.Fees: 2026 rates: 30-amp full hookup $50 (weekly $300, holidays $60), 50-amp full hookup $60 (weekly $360, holidays $70); tent site with 20-amp electric $45. Monthly sites $700 (30-amp) / $750 (50-amp) plus metered electric.
field_notes.Sites: 'Large waterview back in site' for both 30- and 50-amp full-hookup sites; 'We can accommodate most any size rig'. Monthly sites too (RVs no older than 10 years unless approved).

name: Stokesville Campground
note: Campground at the edge of George Washington NF near Mount Solon (Augusta Co), popular with mountain bikers - trails start behind the park; 113 sites, mostly tent. Full-hookup pull-thrus with 50/30-amp; 2-night minimum on weekends. Google 4.7 over 164 reviews. --Claude

Booking: min stay 2 nights on weekends, 3 on holidays

field_notes.Booking: Reserve on CampLife, paid in full in advance. RV camping: two-night minimum on weekends; three nights over Memorial Day weekend, July 3-6 and some event weekends (Red Wing Roots, Shenandoah 100).
field_notes.Fees: Back-in 30-amp water/sewer sites $40 a night, 50-amp full-hookup pull-throughs $50, before tax; any vehicle with a trailer or camper pays at least $40. Extra vehicles $10 a day. CampLife adds its own $3.50 per booking. Quoted on CampLife for October 2026 through June 2027.
field_notes.Sites: RV sites: pull-throughs P1-P9 (CampLife lists P2 at 45 ft, P6 at 40 ft) and back-ins #7-9 and 14-24 (most 'No RVs greater than 28'', RV 8 for pop-ups and campers under 20 ft only, P8 25 ft). Two overflow field sites share a 30-amp pole with no sewer. The rest are tent sites and two rustic cabins. Motorhomes must unhook a towed car before the entrance road (the operator suggests the Stokesville Church lot, 1/4 mile away).

name: Riverbank Campground
note: One of the newer campgrounds in the Raystown Lake region, on the Juniata River minutes from Huntingdon: every camper site full hookup (water/sewer, 30/50A), online booking; seasonal sites and a dump station too. Class A RVs over 32 ft not accepted; 13'6" bridge clearance on the way in. Google 4.5 over 45 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Book online on the campground's own site; reservations are paid in full when made. Camper check-in 5-9 pm, check-out by 2 pm. Full refund less a 3% card fee 30+ days out, 50% at 15-29 days, none inside 15 days. Seasonal sites, worker stays and dump-station use by inquiry.
field_notes.Fees: Full-hookup camper sites from $46 a night on the campground's own booking page (C21 from $48); riverfront tent sites from $37.20, cabin from $139.60. Paid in full at booking.
field_notes.Sites: Camper sites are back-in only and listed for campers up to 33-34 ft (one titled 36 ft); 'We cannot accommodate any Class A RVs over 32'.' Bridge clearance on the way in is 13 ft 6 in. Also riverfront tent sites (about 20 x 40 ft) and a cabin.

name: Niagara Shores Campground & Conference Center
note: Campground and conference center on Lake Rd above the Lake Ontario shore at Appleton (Niagara Co), among the fruit farms east of Olcott; lakeview full-hookup sites along the bluff, larger 50-amp sites in a quieter area, and dry-camping spots. Google 4.5 over 113 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Season: Campspot shows every campsite 'closed for your dates' from the night of Oct 31, 2026 and lists nothing for November-April; the opening date is not posted. The hotel and conference center operate year-round.
field_notes.Booking: Campspot or 716-778-8568; online booking closes 72 hours before arrival. The lakeview full-hookup sites showed a 2-night minimum on every late-October weeknight probed; the dry-camping sites took one night. Payment is due 2 weeks before arrival; no refunds (credit for another date at management's discretion).
field_notes.Fees: Campspot, one night for 2 adults, before tax: weekdays in late October 2026 the Dry Camping RV Site (no hookups) $42, Lakeview 30-amp full hookup $51, Large 50-amp full hookup $51, Lakeview 50-amp $53; Saturday Oct 31 $47 dry and $63-65 full hookup. 2 guests per site, +$10 a person a night; pets $6 each (max $12 a stay).
field_notes.Sites: 12 full-hookup RV sites (Lakeview 30- and 50-amp, Large 50-amp) plus dry-camping spots the office assigns by rig size at check-in, and tent sites.

name: Old Fort RV Park
note: RV park on Parker Padgett Rd near Old Fort (McDowell Co), at the foot of the Blue Ridge east of Asheville; officially reopened (operator's site, 2026). Level concrete lots; the premium back-ins line Brevard Creek. Google 4.7 over 42 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: Short stays book on Campspot; stays of two weeks or more by phone (828-655-6333). Optional $25 site-lock fee.
field_notes.Fees: Campspot quote for 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-14 (same both nights): small back-in $29, large back-in $39, premium and oversized premium back-in (Brevard Creek) $49, pull-through $59, plus a $3 reservation booking fee; matches the operator's first rate table ($29/$39/$49/$59, monthly $600-900). A second table on the operator's page lists $49-79 nightly with weekly and monthly rates.
field_notes.Sites: 40 back-in lots up to 60 ft deep and 10 pull-throughs 90 ft deep (4 of them buddy lots), all 35 ft wide, level concrete; 21 premium lots back onto Brevard Creek. Campspot sets max RV length 60 ft (back-ins) and 90 ft (pull-throughs); small back-ins are 45 ft deep.

name: Ladd Pond Cabins and Campground
note: Cabins and campground on Ladd Pond Rd in Stewartstown, in New Hampshire's far north near Pittsburg and the Connecticut Lakes; RV sites with 30-amp and water (most with sewer), to 45 ft; ResNexus booking. Google 4.7 over 98 reviews. --Claude

field_notes.Fees: RV site (30-amp/water/sewer, max 30 ft) $45/night; tent sites $25.

name: Heirloom Hamlet
note: Family homestead off Carters Mill Rd near Ridgeland, minutes from I-95; booked through Hipcamp (Good Sam members request through the website). Outdoor shower and a separating dry toilet, no conventional bathhouse - the hosts say plainly it is a homestead, not a traditional campground. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: The operator's site sends bookings to Hipcamp, also takes calls (561-859-8987), and has a request form for Good Sam members. One-night stays bookable (Hipcamp minNights 1).
field_notes.Fees: $33 no hookup, $44 electric/water, $55 full hookup. Host's nightly price; Hipcamp adds a service fee (about 18%) at checkout.
field_notes.Sites: Four RV/van sites: Americano (no hookups, rigs to 30 ft), Latte (electric/water, to 24 ft), Espresso and Cappuccino (full hookup, to 45 ft); plus two cabins (Walden Cottage, A-frame).

name: 7 Oaks R.V. Park
note: RV park on Bolton Ave in Hudson, between US-19 and Little Road; pool, shuffleboard and a social calendar. About 125 of its 297 sites hold permanent units. --Claude

field_notes.Booking: 'We are a first come first serve RV park call for availability.' Office open 9:00-4:30 Monday to Friday, closed weekends and holidays.
field_notes.Fees: 2025/2026 rates for 2 people: daily $50 with all hookups (no cable); extra person $3 a night. Weekly $250; monthly $640 plus metered electric and water.
field_notes.Sites: 297 RV sites, about 125 of them holding permanent units; 140 open sites, most concrete pads 45 ft deep and 18-20 ft wide plus a grass strip.
